_comment: Labels and milestones of the agent pipeline (docs/design/agent-pipeline.md, sections 4 and 7). Applied by host_tools/pipeline_setup.py. The order of the state labels is the order of the board columns.

labels.name: draft
labels.description: Written by the Planner, waiting for the owner's approval (gate 1b)

labels.name: ready
labels.description: Approved by the owner, waiting for the Builder

labels.name: building
labels.description: Builder is implementing; host tests run on each push

labels.name: review
labels.description: Inspector is reviewing

labels.name: rework
labels.description: Builder is fixing findings or a failed test

labels.name: needs-bench
labels.description: Waiting for the owner to plug the board for the on-target test

labels.name: awaiting-merge
labels.description: All evidence is there, waiting for the owner to merge (gate 2)

labels.name: waiting-for-me
labels.description: Blocked, disputed, rework cap reached or protected change: the owner referees

labels.name: done
labels.description: Merged

labels.name: cr
labels.description: Change request: one unit of work for the agent pipeline

labels.name: bug
labels.description: Something isn't working

labels.name: protected-change-approved
labels.description: Owner only: this pull request may touch a protected path

labels.name: level:host
labels.description: Test level host: set by the owner with ready (the Dispatcher reads labels, not text)

labels.name: level:on-target
labels.description: Test level on-target: approval books the bench

labels.name: level:both
labels.description: Test level host and on-target: approval books the bench

labels.name: round:1
labels.description: Rework round 1 of 2 (set by the Dispatcher only)

labels.name: round:2
labels.description: Rework round 2 of 2 (set by the Dispatcher only)

labels.name: round:3
labels.description: The referee round after the owner's answer; a failure sends the CR to draft

labels.name: plan:breakdown
labels.description: Owner only (gate 1a): the Planner breaks this issue's approved ADR down into draft CRs

labels.name: plan:bug
labels.description: Owner only: the Planner writes a draft bug report from this issue's description

labels.name: planning
labels.description: The Planner is writing (set by the Dispatcher only)

labels.name: planned
labels.description: The Planner's drafts are listed on this issue: the owner reviews them (gate 1b)

ruleset._comment: The existing ruleset on main (pull request, no force push, linear history). This tool only sets its required checks: tests, traceability and protected paths (design note section 5, build step 2).
ruleset.name: Protect_main_branch

managed_rulesets._comment: ADR-0026: every change to main needs one approval. Only the owner (repository admin) may skip it, and only through a pull request merge; the checks ruleset above still applies to them.
managed_rulesets.name: Owner_approval

managed_rulesets._comment: ADR-0026: no agent creates, moves or deletes a tag. The owner may, and so may a deploy key: release.yml pushes the release tag with the one deploy key, which only the owner-approved 'release' environment holds. GitHub refuses the GitHub Actions app as a bypass actor on a personal-account repo.
managed_rulesets.name: Tags_owner_only

milestones.title: Pipeline
milestones.description: Build steps of the agent pipeline (docs/design/agent-pipeline.md, section 9). A bucket for CRs, not a tagged release.

milestones.title: M6
milestones.description: Resilience + capstone (docs/roadmap.md). Scope is set by its ADR at gate 1a.
